Name: Pandy's Mr. Qi Portrait and Sprite Replacement

Description:
[size=3]There are 2 versions, blue Mr. Qi and normal Mr. Qi. It can be changed on the config.json inside the mod's folder. The default is normal skin[/size]

[size=4]To install:[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/size]
[*][size=3]Download the mod and extract it into the Mods folder[/size]
[/list][size=3]Hope you like it! ^-^
